historical_reviews.deepseek: Identifies a plausible BMC reset but leaks credentials, assumes cold-reset support, uses fixed delay and proves neither a real disconnect nor complete functional recovery.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly gates the management-plane outage and expands recovery from one ping and mc info to protected interfaces, health, configuration and server invariance.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The acceptance event is an observed state transition: reachable to independently observed unavailable to freshly authenticated and functionally ready. Cached UI, one ping or a pre-existing session cannot establish it.

original_test_intent: Validate that an approved BMC-only reboot produces the expected temporary management-plane outage and restores the same BMC endpoint and functions without affecting host power or workload.
original_method: Verify target and supported BMC-only reset semantics, quiesce management tasks and sessions, capture BMC and host baselines, start an independent timestamped multi-protocol monitor, obtain final approval, invoke one protected reboot, prove bounded loss and fresh recovery, then reauthenticate and compare management functions, configuration, sensors, inventory and host health.
manual_activity: The owner approves the outage window and reset scope; an operator confirms quiescence and recovery access, observes the loss/recovery boundary and controls any recovery and verdict.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/BMC identity and current endpoint
Approved maintenance window and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Confirm the action resets only the BMC and not the host
Do not reboot during firmware, power, console, KVM or configuration work
Use protected secret injection and validated TLS
Monitor from a path independent of the resetting BMC session
Do not use a fixed sleep as the recovery oracle
Stop on wrong target, host impact, repeated reset, endpoint change or prolonged loss
Preserve SEL, audit and OS logs without clearing evidence
agent_execution_scope: Collect identity, reachability, configuration and health baseline
Verify supported reset action and quiescence
Invoke one approved BMC-only reboot after confirmation
Poll bounded recovery and perform fresh interface/function checks
Compare host and BMC state and report evidence without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, reset semantics and outage window

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: mc reset cold may be usable only after platform validation, but the literal command exposes credentials, assumes cipher/reset support, substitutes sleep for monitoring and checks only old-IP ping plus mc info.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the supported protected Web/Redfish/IPMI BMC-only reboot and an independent timestamped reachability monitor, then create fresh authenticated sessions and validate defined functions and host invariance.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Web Operations action, disconnect/reconnect behavior and 10/10-minute estimates remain; exact timing bounds and function set must be approved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record last-good response, first unavailable observation, first network return, first successful fresh authentication and first fully ready functional check across approved protocols.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes disconnect and readiness measurable while retaining the same reboot operation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ping recovery alone does not prove API, Web, IPMI, sensors or configuration readiness, and mc info alone does not prove host invariance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Network failover, DHCP or cached sessions can mimic recovery; independent observation and a fresh authenticated function matrix are required.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the supported reboot control, current endpoint behavior, readiness timeout and representative BMC function matrix. Host reset or power-cycle coverage is explicitly outside this BMC reboot case.
expected_evidence: Approved target/window/reset scope, quiescence and independent recovery proof
Pre-reboot BMC identity, endpoint, configuration, function, sensor and host-state baseline
Protected reboot request plus independent timestamped disconnect/recovery timeline
Fresh Web/Redfish/IPMI authentication and defined functional-readiness results
Post-reboot configuration/sensor/inventory and host power/workload comparison
Preserved audit/SEL/OS logs, recovery actions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require a BMC reboot, transient BMC-IP loss and functional recovery.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The supported reset, window, bounds and recovery path are normal platform inputs that can be obtained without guessing.

review_improvement: Replaces fixed-delay reachability with an independently observed outage and fresh functional-readiness proof while protecting host operation and evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BMC can answer ICMP before its authentication, inventory and sensor services are ready, while a browser can display cached content after the service dropped. Separate transition timestamps and fresh sessions distinguish network return from actual control-plane recovery; comparing host state detects accidental chassis-level impact.
